name: GENM
recent: Genting Malaysia 近期持续进行股份回购，并有多项企业公告，包括清盘相关事项。新闻方面，公司涉及 Genting Sky City 项目的法律纠纷，同时有报道指其 4Q25 EBITDA 因海外业务增长而上升，但 RAM 维持负向展望并提及债务上升。
notable: 公司根据 Section 127(16) of CA 2016 发出股份回购通知，并有多项即时股份回购公告。
公司发布清盘 / 接管人 / 限制令 / 特别管理人相关公告。
Genting 集团成功阻止 Sycal 的 Genting Sky City 项目，高等法院下令进行斜坡修复。
risks: RAM 确认 Genting 的 AA1 评级，但基于债务上升维持负向展望。
有报道指 Genting 面临债务偿还压力，并计划将部分供股所得用于利息和融资成本。
Genting Sky City 项目涉及法律纠纷，高等法院已下令进行斜坡修复。
earnings: 截至 2026-06-30 季度，营收为 MYR 3,853.3 million，环比增长 34.4%，同比增长 32.0%；净收入为 MYR 47.4 million，净利率 1.2%，净收入同比下降 88.6%。

recent_en: Genting Malaysia has been actively buying back shares and made several corporate announcements, including a winding-up related matter. In the news, the company is involved in legal disputes over the Genting Sky City project, while reports note a jump in 4Q25 EBITDA on overseas growth, though RAM maintained a negative outlook citing rising debt.
notable_en: The company made an announcement related to winding up / receiver & manager / restraining order / special administrator.
The Genting group succeeded in halting Sycal's Genting Sky City project, and the High Court ordered slope restoration at the site.
risks_en: RAM affirmed Genting's AA1 ratings but maintained a negative outlook on rising debt.
Reports indicate looming debt repayment for Genting, with part of rights issue proceeds allocated to interest and financing costs.
The Genting Sky City project is subject to legal disputes, and the High Court has ordered slope restoration.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 2026-06-30, revenue was MYR 3,853.3 million, up 34.4% QoQ and 32.0% YoY; net income was MYR 47.4 million with a net margin of 1.2%, down 88.6% YoY.
